teaser.en: Carpenters know a mvure plank by its smell, and its timber is so prized that the tree is now rare in Kenya.
teaser.sw: Maseremala hutambua ubao wa mvure kwa harufu yake, na mbao zake zinathaminiwa sana kiasi kwamba mti huu sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya.
teaser.dg: Mafundi a mbao nkumanya libao ra *mvure* kpwa arufuye, na mbao za muhi uhu zina samani kulu hata sambi ukakala adimu Kenya.

summary.en: *Mvure* is the mvule or iroko, a giant forest tree with a tall clean trunk and one of the finest timbers in Africa. Prized for furniture, doors and boats, it has been cut so heavily that it is now rare in Kenya.
summary.sw: *Mvure* ni mvule, mti mkubwa mno wa msituni wenye shina refu lisilo na matawi na mojawapo ya mbao bora zaidi barani Afrika. Unathaminiwa kwa samani, milango na mashua, na umekatwa kwa wingi sana kiasi kwamba sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya.
summary.dg: *Mvure* ni muhi mkulu sana wa tsaka, wenye kolo rire risiro na panda, na mbaoze ni kahi ya mbao nono zaidi Afrika. Atu nkumendza mbaoze kpwa kuhenda fanicha, myango na madau, na ukakatwa sana hata sambi ni adimu Kenya.

about.en:
*Mvure* is a giant, reaching 30 metres, with a tall, straight trunk free of branches and a high, umbrella-shaped crown. The bark is pale grey and oozes a milky latex when cut. The leaves are large and oval. It drops its leaves in the dry season.

The heartwood is golden-brown and resists termites.
about.sw:
*Mvure* ni mti mkubwa mno, unaofikia mita 30, wenye shina refu lililonyooka lisilo na matawi na taji la juu lenye umbo la mwavuli. Gamba ni la kijivu hafifu na hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa likikatwa. Majani ni makubwa na ya umbo la yai. Hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi.

Kiini cha mbao ni cha rangi ya kahawia-dhahabu na hakiliwi na mchwa.
about.dg:
*Mvure* ni muhi mkulu sana, unaofika mita 30, wenye kolo rire rinaroima chocho bila panda. Dzulu sana, panda na makodza ganaenea dza mwamvuri. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya. Makodzage ni makulu na ga umbo ra yai. Makodzage ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

Chiiniche ni cha rangi ya dongo iriyo dza zahabu, na tachiriwa ni lutswa.

where.en: It grows in lowland, riverine and groundwater forest. At the coast it is only occasional, though it is common around Rabai, inland of Mombasa. Remaining big trees stand mostly in forest remnants.
where.sw: Hustawi katika misitu ya nyanda za chini, ya kando ya mito na ya maeneo yenye maji ya ardhini. Pwani hupatikana hapa na pale tu, ingawa ni mwingi kuzunguka Rabai, bara kutoka Mombasa. Miti mikubwa iliyobaki imesimama hasa katika mabaki ya misitu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi ya photsi, kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye matsaka ganayomera kpwa madzi ga tsini. Pwani unaphahikana mara chache tu, ela ni wa kawaida kuzunguluka Rabai, bara ya Mombasa. Mihi mikulu iriyosala minji inaima kpwenye vipande vya matsaka virivyosala.

uses.en:
*Mvure* is a premier timber, used for quality furniture indoors and out, for doors, boats, poles and tool handles. The heartwood resists termites.

The bark is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
*Mvure* ni mbao za daraja la kwanza, zinazotumika kwa samani bora za ndani na nje, kwa milango, mashua, nguzo na mipini ya zana. Kiini cha mbao hakiliwi na mchwa.

Gamba hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg:
*Mvure* ni mbao za hali ya dzulu, zinazohumirwa kuhenda fanicha nono za ndani na za kondze, myango, madau, nguzo na mipini ya vilwilo. Chiini cha muhi uhu tachiriwa ni lutswa.

Gophare nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Digo carpenters recognise *mvure* planks by their strong smell. Its seeds have their own name, *tembe za mvure*. Carpenters also take care to tell it apart from *mnguonguo*, the 'false mvule', whose wood looks similar but does not last.
culture.sw: Maseremala Wadigo hutambua mbao za *mvure* kwa harufu yake kali. Mbegu zake zina jina lake maalum, *tembe za mvure*. Maseremala pia huwa makini kuutofautisha na *mnguonguo*, 'mvule bandia', ambao mbao zake zinafanana lakini hazidumu.
culture.dg: Mafundi a mbao a Chidigo nkumanya mbao za *mvure* kpwa arufu yao kali. Tembeze nazo zina dzina rao: *tembe za mvure*. Mafundi piya nkulola sana kuutafwautisha na *mnguonguo*, 'mvure wa handzo', ambao mbaoze zinaoneka sawa ela tazikaa.

names.en: Pakia, the ICRAF handbook and the Mgombato dictionary all give the Digo name *mvure*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mvule*; the Digo *r* matches the Swahili *l*. Mgombato calls it a hardwood, 'East African teak'. In English it is mvule or iroko.
names.sw: Pakia, kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato wote wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mvure*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvule*; *r* ya Kidigo inalingana na *l* ya Kiswahili. Mgombato anauita mti wa mbao ngumu, 'mtiki wa Afrika Mashariki'. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mvule* au *iroko*.
names.dg: Pakia, chitabu cha ICRAF na Mgombato vyosi vinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mvure*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiriama. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mvule*; *r* ya Chidigo i phatu pha *l* ya Chiswahili. Mgombato unauiha muhi mgumu, 'East African teak'. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mvule* au *iroko*.

conservation.en: Mvure is now rare in Kenya because of over-exploitation for its timber.
conservation.sw: Mvure sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya kwa sababu ya kuvunwa kupita kiasi kwa ajili ya mbao zake.
conservation.dg: *Mvure* sambi ni adimu Kenya kpwa sababu ukakatwa sana kuhendza mbaoze.

reason.en: Another timber known by the smell of its planks
reason.sw: Mbao nyingine inayotambuliwa kwa harufu ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao unaomanyikana kpwa arufu ya mbaoze

reason.en: Its seeds are also called tembe

reason.sw: Mbao nyingine inayothaminiwa ambayo sasa ni adimu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao za samani, ambao sambi ni adimu

reason.en: A giant of the same fig family
reason.sw: Mti mkubwa mno wa familia ileile ya mitini
reason.dg: Muhi mkulu wanjina wa jamii iyo iyo ya makuyu

definition.en: The seeds of the mvule tree. They have no use, so they are called 'seeds of …'; the useful timber goes by the tree's own name.
definition.sw: Mbegu za mvule. Hazina matumizi, kwa hivyo huitwa 'mbegu za …'; mbao zenye manufaa hujulikana kwa jina la mti wenyewe.
definition.dg: Tembe za muhi wa mvure. Tazina kazi, kpwa hivyo nkuihwa 'tembe za …'; mbao zenye kazi zinaihwa kpwa dzina ra muhi wenye.

mgombato: mvure1 (mi) type of hardwood tree, East-African teak-tree (Milicia excelsa); mvule.
